steps.note: Open the prepared Technical + RFQ event; this is the required first step for the prepared state.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Open Master QCS for the closed event so the final bid and award flow can be inspected.
Verify that the best final bid is ranked according to the lowest bid amount.
Enter the award allocation screen after bidding has closed.
Allocate all line items to the vendor with the best final bid.
Confirm the complete line and vendor allocation before submitting the proposal.
Create and submit the award proposal for the best final bid.
Assert that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete the award approval flow and create the purchase order.
Verify that the created purchase order contains the awarded line item.
